newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Chile's Luksic group looks to grow in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Luksic group looks to grow in Brazil.

text.p: Chile's Luksic group is looking to increase its investments in Brazil, especially in the telecommunications, financial, mining and food sectors, according to Brazil's private National Industry Confederation (CNI).

Luksic Director Guillermo Luksic met with CNI Vice-President Arthur Joao Donato and CNI Executive Director Jose Augusto Coelho Fernandes this week to inform himself better about Brazil's economic opening, structural reforms and economic stabilization.

"We feel very comfortable and welcome in Brazil, a country which is heading in the right direction," the CNI quoted Luksic as saying in a statement. Luksic said the group's investment policy was "dynamic without being risky."
The Luksic group, which has an annual turnover of $7.1 billion, acquired a 67 percent stake in Brazil's second largest copper cable maker Ficap SA only six months ago via its Madeco SA subsidiary.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
